Package br.edu.unipampa.varzinho.application

Class ManageGym

java.lang.Object
br.edu.unipampa.varzinho.application.ManageGym
public final class ManageGym extends Object
Changes the gym's structure and exposes only immutable views of it.

Every change is applied to the gym first and stored after. When storing fails the change has still happened in this run, and the RepositoryException says it was not kept — a value the storage cannot hold is reported that way too, never as a refusal. A court's display name and sport are the exception: a label the storage cannot hold is undone, or every later change would fail to be stored along with it.

    • removeCourt

      public void removeCourt(int courtNumber) throws RepositoryException
      Takes an empty court out of the gym and stores the gym. The window always works on a selected court, so the only court is kept even though a Gym may be empty.
      Parameters:
      courtNumber - the court to remove
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the gym has no court with that number
      IllegalStateException - if it is the only court or still holds a camera; nothing is removed or stored
      RepositoryException - if the gym cannot be stored; the change stays in this run

    • installSimulatedPtz

      public void installSimulatedPtz(int courtNumber, int pan, int tilt, int zoom) throws RepositoryException
      Installs a simulated PTZ camera already aimed, under the first free id of the form ptz-<court> or ptz-<court>-<n>, and stores the gym. It is not recording.
      Parameters:
      courtNumber - the court that receives the camera
      pan - the horizontal angle to aim at
      tilt - the vertical angle to aim at
      zoom - the zoom level to aim at
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the gym has no court with that number, or a coordinate is outside its range; nothing is installed
      RepositoryException - if the gym cannot be stored; the change stays in this run
